title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude's Chrome extension is now generally available for all paid plan users, allowing Claude to view pages and take autonomous actions without manual approval. The extension includes enhanced prompt-injection defenses through model training improvements and automated verification, with testing showing near-zero attack success rates. This enables seamless Claude integration for websites without native integrations.

title: Claude for Teachers, now available for U.S. K-12 schools and districts
summary: Claude for Teachers expands to a free Enterprise offering for K-12 schools and districts, with centrally managed organizations, SSO, role-based access, and admin dashboard capabilities. New teaching skills include lesson preparation and check-for-understanding features, with content updated in the K-12 Academy. A FERPA-compliant pilot with Detroit Public Schools offers qualifying schools a free year through June 30, 2027.

title: Claude gets its own browser in Cowork
summary: Claude Cowork now includes an isolated, built-in browser that keeps Claude's sessions separate from the user's personal browsing, protecting tabs, bookmarks, and passwords. Users can optionally import logins per site from Chrome, Edge, or Firefox, enabling hands-off web task delegation like research and vendor portal access. The feature includes prompt-injection safeguards and is rolling out to Pro, Max, and Team plans with immediate availability for Enterprise admins.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp built a framework for self-improving Claude agents using a two-skill architecture with a domain-specialized inner skill paired with an outer improver skill that observes feedback and proposes refinements through code review. This approach addresses the 80% accuracy plateau common in agent prompt optimization. Warp is now scaling the framework across its open-source repo with specialized agents for code review, spec-writing, and issue triage.

title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag is a Slack integration that treats Claude as a colleague in threads, pulling workspace context and posting results directly in-thread. Real workflows show significant productivity gains: marketing collateral in 45 minutes, feature consolidation in 26 minutes, and legal review reduced from a day to 30 minutes per asset. Scoped access lets Claude search workspace context without leaving Slack.

title: Bringing the cybersecurity capabilities of Claude Mythos 5 to more defenders
summary: Anthropic expanded Claude Mythos 5's cybersecurity capabilities through integrations with partner tools, enabling enterprises to run security scans via Claude Security. A new $35 million Defender Advantage Fund supports open-source security projects, with access channeled through purpose-built interfaces to balance defensive utility against misuse risks. The Cyber Verification Program now covers broader dual-use capabilities.
